title: Policy
description: Cross-cutting behavioral rule with trigger conditions and gates.

trigger.description: Condition expression (see spec/EXPRESSIONS.md). Use 'always' for unconditional activation.

gate.description: hard = blocks progress if checks fail. soft = advisory.

oneOf.description: Well-known check: run_tests, run_lint, run_build, diff_against:<branch>.

checks.description: Validation checks. All must pass for a hard gate. Well-known: run_tests, run_lint, run_build.

oneOf.description: Well-known action: write_plan, verify_with_user, update_artifact, capture_lessons.

actions.description: Actions to perform when policy triggers. Well-known: write_plan, verify_with_user, update_artifact.

on_failure.description: replan = agent re-plans. retry = re-run checks. escalate = send to user. block = halt task. warn = log and continue.

skip_when.description: Condition expression to skip this policy (see spec/EXPRESSIONS.md).
